title: econ-bootstrapper: automated tenant warmstart + compact sample pruner
author: Asha Mehta
description: Summary: Introduce a lightweight 'econ-bootstrapper' service that auto-generates tenant-specific batching/cache defaults and an optional compact sample pruner used to seed quantization/compact profiles. Motivation: onboarding new tenants often produces cold unit-econ and cache profiles; manual tuning is slow and conservative leading to higher costs. This change automates a safe warmstart that provides conservative batch and cache defaults plus a compact sample selection strategy for early quantization profile suggestions. Design: 1) econ-bootstrapper service runs as a short-lived job after tenant creation or when requested via admin API. 2) It ingests a small anonymized sample of traffic (configurable sampling rate), computes per-tenant sequence length distribution, warm cache prefix candidates, and candidate micro-batch size that respects latency SLOs. 3) The compact sample pruner selects representative traces under size and privacy constraints using a distance heuristic (L2 on token-length histograms and metadata bucketing) and outputs a 1-10KB summary used by the quantizer/optimizer. 4) Results are written to the tenant defaults store and emitted as a suggested profile in the Console UI; changes are opt-in and gated by safety checks. Rollout and safety: default generated profiles are conservative by design with guardrails: a) batch sizes are clamped to preserve 99th percentile latency targets, b) quantization profile suggestions are flagged as "suggested" and not auto-applied, c) bootstrap runs are rate-limited and sampled to avoid platform-wide burst. Implementation highlights: - New service package under internal/econ/bootstrapper with a small state machine, sampling adapters, and a compact pruner module. - Tenant defaults model extended (tenant_defaults.v2) with source=autogen, confidence, and sample_signature fields. - Admin API endpoint POST /admin/tenants/:id/bootstrap that triggers a run and returns a candidate profile preview. - Console additions: new "Suggested Defaults" card with a one-click apply + dry-run option. Testing and telemetry: added unit tests for sample pruner heuristics, integration tests for tenant_defaults migration, and a lightweight end-to-end perf check that runs in CI with mocked samples to validate latency clamps. Telemetry emitted: bootstrap.run.{start,success,failed}, bootstrap.profile_confidence, bootstrap.applied_by. Migration notes: tenant_defaults.v1 is read-first; v2 is written only when autogen runs or when applying a suggested profile. Rollback plan: autogen writes are non-destructive and can be rolled back by clearing source=autogen entries. Docs: console and API docs updated, plus a short runbook in docs/operators/bootstrapping.md. Related work: overlaps with ENG-1842 (tenant warmstart RFC) and ENG-2017 (quant profile suggestion API). Checklist: [x] unit tests [x] integration tests [x] console card [x] e2e perf smoke [x] docs [x] Linear link included.

review_comments: Diego Alvarez: Please add a safety check to clamp the computed batch size based on the tenant's percentiles and a feature-flag guard for early rollouts.
Author (Asha Mehta): Added percentile clamp and a runtime feature flag (feature.econ.bootstrapper). The clamp uses 99th latency SLO from tenant config when available; default fallback is 250ms.
Ruth Kim: The pruner heuristic is fine but add a test that validates the pruned sample remains representative for heavy-tailed distributions.
Author (Asha Mehta): Added heavy-tail unit test with synthetic distributions. Also added notes to README explaining tradeoffs and explainability output.
Tom Nguyen: CI perf smoke flaked once on a noisy runner; suggest marking the smoke as retryable and lower sample sizes in CI.
Author (Asha Mehta): Adjusted CI smoke to use mocked samples and made the benchmark retryable with three attempts; documented flakiness mitigation in ci/bootsmoke/README.md.
merge_details: Merged by Ruth Kim on 2026-02-18 via squash-merge. Merge commit includes a condensed changelog and migration note. Post-merge: feature.econ.bootstrapper default=false; rollout scheduled to 10% of new tenants for 2 weeks.
release_notes: Introduce econ-bootstrapper: automated tenant warmstart to generate conservative batch/cache defaults and compact sample summaries.
Add admin API to trigger bootstrap runs and Console UI to preview suggested profiles.
Tenant defaults schema v2 (tenant_defaults.v2) introduced; autogen writes are non-destructive and opt-in.
